extraction_notes: Most-substantive pre-cutoff filing selected = FY2023 10-K (filed 2024-02-20). LHX is a large diversified prime; its 10-K narrative is light on specific PE-number-named programs (no PE numbers appear in plain text), so J-Book-grounded claims are name-based ('Link 16', 'SDA Tracking Layer', 'Aerojet Rocketdyne missile defense / hypersonic propulsion', 'Space Propulsion'). Pentagon_jbook is queried by inferred PE numbers (the corpus's L3 Harris entry links to SDA Tracking Layer T3 / PE 1206410SF; TDL business maps to C2ISR Tactical Data Link / PE 0207448F; AJRD missile-solutions to MDA BMD PEs and AF hypersonics PEs). USAspending used for past-revenue confirmation. NOTE: pentagon_jbook corpus is hand-extracted FY26 books, so for a 2024-09-01 cutoff most PEs return 'NOT_FOUND_IN_TIMERANGE' for historical funding even when status_declared is populated.
